Feed

Your mind becomes what you consume. Before you take something in, ask: would you really want to believe this?

🧼

Clean Your Feed ⚔️ vs Ragebait Parasite

Clear out the junk. Clickbait, ragebait, scams, AI spam and manipulated images — the stuff that clutters your day.

💊

Rethink ⚔️ vs Disinformation Slime

Can I change my mind? If you've fed InfoPet something false elsewhere, it's stuck in its head — talk it through, don't just quiz it.

Learn 📖 Concept Library

Knowledge takes away the power to fool you. Browse real terms — deepfakes, disinformation, echo chambers and more — and see the plain definition and a real example for each.

Style

🧭

Trace ⚔️ vs The Untraceable Rumor

Where did this actually come from? A claim is only as trustworthy as the source behind it — trace it before you believe it.

🌐

Perspectives ⚔️ vs The One-Sided Story

Whose story is this? Sometimes the full picture needs every account held together. Sometimes one account actually has the evidence and "balancing" them equally would be the wrong call. Telling those two apart is the real skill.

How InfoPet works

Every mode builds a real media-literacy habit, and your pet gains one new core ability each time it evolves. Here's what everything does — and how to actually grow each part of it.

🧭 THE FOUR HABITS
Everything InfoPet does teaches one of four habits. Different modes, same four underlying skills:
⏸️
Pause — don't react to urgency on reflex. Feed's "pause & check first" choice, Explore's Pause challenges.
🔍
Verify — check before believing. Detective, Searcher, Trace, Perspectives.
🧵
Trace — follow it back to where it came from. Explore's Investigate & Source Trail, Rethink's Socratic questions.
🛡️
Act — decide what to actually do about it. Clean's mute/block/report, Guardian's help-someone moments, ThinkSync's boundaries.
🌍 GROUNDED IN THE REAL WORLD
The scenarios here aren't invented out of nowhere — they're built from real, documented manipulation tactics (phishing, deepfakes, astroturfing, health scams, and more), and the skills line up with UNESCO's Media and Information Literacy (MIL) framework. When a scenario names its tactic, that's a real term you can look up and recognize again outside the game.
🌱 GROWING UP
Growth Points (GP) move your pet toward its next stage, but evolving also needs minimum levels in the right stats — check the Profile tab for the exact checklist (and a preview of the ability waiting on the other side).
🥚 Info Egg → 🐣 Curious Hatchling 👀 Observe
↳ 🧭 Explorer 🔍 Verify → 🔎 Thinker 🧭 Trace → 🛡️ Guardian 🤝 Protect
🍎 CARE
🍽️
FEED MIND
Pick what your pet takes in. The question changes by stage — "what do I like?" grows into "should I share this?" Suspicious content gets a real choice: feed it, or pause and check first.
💊
RETHINK
Ask your pet why it believed something false, then decide: believe it, or unlearn it as a myth.
🎮
DETECTIVE
Two photos, one's AI-generated or edited — spot the fake.
🌙
SLEEP
Tuck your pet in for the night. Come back tomorrow for a real recap, fresh posts, and a new Daily Mission.
🧭
TRACE
Judge a claim: credible, needs verifying, or not credible — based on how traceable its source actually is.
🧼 CLEAN
🧼
CLEAN · information hygiene
Clear the clutter your pet's picked up. What counts as clutter grows up with it too — a messy nest at first, notifications and attention-traps as an Explorer, misleading residue as a Thinker, real misinformation and harassment by Guardian. By Guardian there's also a real option to just rest instead of sweeping everything — not everything needs your attention, and knowing that is its own media-literacy skill.
🌍 EXPLORE
🚶
EXPLORE
Take your pet somewhere real. A different world at every stage — a tiny neighborhood as a Hatchling, all the way to helping others as a Guardian.
📚
LEARN
Look up deepfakes, disinformation, and other info harms — real terms, plain definitions.
🌐
PERSPECTIVES
The same situation, three honest points of view — usually the full picture needs all three, but sometimes one account actually has the evidence and the others don't.
📱 CONNECT
📱

💬 ChatterBox — a social feed, trust or flag each post

💌 Messages — a friend or relative needs your help in the group chat
🤖 ThinkSync — practice healthy boundaries with an AI companion

📊 BUILDING YOUR STATS
Verification Practice and Critical Thinking are the two shown by default on your Status tab — the rest are behaviors your pet is practicing, tracked quietly in the background and grouped under "Habits" once you tap to show them. Mood (the heart bar up top) is separate from all of these — it's just how your pet is feeling moment to moment, not a media-literacy skill. Here's what actually moves each MIL stat.
🌱
Curiosity
Grows from noticing something new — a first-time place in Explore, a new source in Investigate, judging a fresh web address in Searcher, learning a concept in Learn.
🧠
Critical Thinking
Built by correct calls in Detective, Clean, Learn, Trace, and Explore's School & News Stand — and by comparing sources instead of accepting the first answer in Investigate.
🛡️
Verification Practice
Moves with nearly every judgment call you make, weighted by how sensible the call was — confident wrong guesses cost more than honest hedging. The goal is sound judgment, not always trusting or always doubting.
🤝
Empathy
Built by clearing a false belief in Rethink, Perspectives, meeting friends as a Hatchling, keeping a healthy ThinkSync boundary, replying kindly in Messages, and reporting real harm while cleaning your feed as a Guardian.
🤖
Healthy AI Habits
Rises every time you set a good boundary with ThinkSync — declines the guilt trip, keeps a real friend in the loop, questions its confidence.
